scope: U301/U803 only. Existing native library geometry is the starting point. No live API, KiCad mutation, or KiCad library import.

coordinates.frame: Native footprint local, top-side, rotation 0, +x right and +y up. Coordinates match source/API signs.
coordinates.apply_transform: world_mm = component_origin_mil * 0.0254 + R(component_rotation) * local_mm; verify numbered pad anchors before any mutation.
coordinates.anchor_check_reason: Initial getAllPins coordinates are rounded to 0.1mil; exact library coordinates retained here.
coordinates.never_use_as_placement: initial-state components are unplaced outside the 99mm outline; their current absolute positions are evidence only.

primary_sources.evidence: EPAD soldering is optional; amount must be controlled if soldered. Recommended 0.9mm islands on 1.4mm pitch and thermal-via pattern.
Module antenna outside board edge; antenna clearance and housing clearance.
Device port 0.25±0.05mm is distinct from PCB drill; signal pads 0.60x0.40, GND ring OD1.65/ID1.05.
PCB acoustic hole at least0.50mm and unplated; sealing solder joint; 0.10–0.12mm stencil and 0.8–0.9 linear aperture ratio.

datum.kicad_to_native_ep_mapping: x_native=x_kicad-0.000124; y_native=-y_kicad+3.634877. For thermal pattern only, anchored on EP center; do not apply blindly to all perimeter pads.
datum.perimeter_difference_note: The native bottom row differs from a rigid KiCad mapping by about0.03mm; native pad26 has its own approx0.03mm y offset. Do not silently move numbered perimeter lands in this EP/keepout task.

central_copper.implementation: Keep nine native SMD41 anchors as electrical anchors; union with a native project-instance GND copper rectangle. Disable all central automatic paste; do not import any KiCad footprint.
central_copper.mask: One TOP mask opening following3.9x3.9mm copper, zero expansion. Explicit no-paste; continuous copper does not imply an EP solder joint.

thermal_vias.implementation: Twelve native through VIAs or plated MULTI pads; do not duplicate after a repeated application. No resin fill, copper cap or guaranteed tenting required. TOP EP opening merges with via mask.
thermal_vias.ground_plane_contract: Every hole must connect solidly to local EP copper and the continuous INNER_1 GND plane, then available INNER_2/BOTTOM GND. Do not rely on only a serial via chain or thermal spokes. Keep peripheral GND1/40 independently connected to planes because EP is not soldered.

paste_policy.r14_conflict_resolution: r14 source has nine0.90x0.90 central apertures (7.29mm²). r9/r10 DIY stencil deliberately removed them. This native implementation adopts the existing DIY manufacturing choice, not the raw r14 F.Paste.
paste_policy.reason: EP solder is optional per ESP_DS p41. No paste over open PTH eliminates this designed solder-wicking path and avoids module lift from excessive center paste; it is compatible with hand-aligned stencil reflow without paid hole filling.
paste_policy.limits: Twelve PCB holes still improve PCB ground connectivity but no claim of soldered EP thermal equivalence. Verify module temperature and RF behavior under representative Wi-Fi/CPU load.

antenna.placement: Antenna projects beyond the PCB edge. In native0deg orientation antenna points +Y. Keepout start rounds conservatively below actual antenna boundary; front/side bounds provide15mm around nominal18mm antenna.
antenna.region_implementation: Native REGION on each copper layer; use documented prohibit types. Component prohibition needs exception for U301 itself, so enforce other component/cable/battery/speaker/enclosure exclusion separately if native REGION flags collide with owner body.
antenna.mechanical_keepout: Preserve this exclusion outside the board too; do not clip the record to99x99mm and lose the enclosure/cable requirement.
antenna.cam_requirement: All four copper Gerbers intersected with in-board antenna exclusion must be empty. REGION existence alone is insufficient.

existing.api_hole_fields_note: Initial-state exposes small non-null hole fields on TOP polygon pads4. TOP-layer virtual pad fields are not evidence of physical drill hits.

U803.correction_to_previous_report: No MULTI PAD/VIA does NOT prove absence of holes. Official PCB_PrimitivePad.getAll remarks explicitly mention embedded FOOTPRINT FILL layer12 as positioning-hole geometry. e13 can be an actual native hole and must be checked in baseline Excellon before replacement.

MULTI_FILL_handling.primary: Resize existing native MULTI FILL e13 to exact0.30mm radius (0.60mm diameter), preserving center and NPTH interpretation. Baseline Excellon has proved this entity is a real hole. Do not add another coincident hole.
MULTI_FILL_handling.alternative: If source/API mutation cannot preserve native FILL hole semantics, remove e13 and replace with exactly one explicit nonmetallized mechanical hole; then repeat CAM. Never retain both.
MULTI_FILL_handling.baseline_gate: CLOSED: baseline Excellon proves one0.30002mm NPTH at(6.9995,-68.0009). Final0.60mm CAM gate remains open.
MULTI_FILL_handling.do_not_do: Do not retain e13 plus add a coincident0.60mm drill; do not change to plated via; do not assume FILL is decorative.

acoustic_hole.implementation: Use resized existing native MULTI FILL e13, confirmed baseline NPTH. Verify final0.60mm unplated Excellon hit and no duplicate. Explicit PAD replacement is fallback only.

acoustic_keepout.pad_rule: Also geometrically audit all pads; intentional annulus begins at r0.525mm, outside the keepout. The NPTH owner is exempt from copper-pad prohibition.
acoustic_keepout.bottom_mechanical: Keep board underside sound passage open; no tape, cable, gasket occlusion or direct mounting on a solid surface.

GND4_ring.shape: Four exact contiguous90deg annular-sector TOP pads; each carries number4/GND. No0.20mm slots in copper or mask; union must be one annulus.
GND4_ring.connection: Connect outer rim to GND outside acoustic keepout; stitch with a0.30/0.60 GND via outside the microphone solder/mask/body envelope after placement. Never pierce the sealing annulus with a via.
GND4_ring.current_gap_correction: Existing4 disconnected native polygons are not an acceptable continuous sealing land even though they share number4.

steel_bridges.definition: Subtract |x-cx|<.075 OR |y-cy|<.075 from ring paste; copper and mask remain continuous.

paste.raw_vs_manufacturing: Raw r14 footprint is a continuous paste ring, but its proper DIY stencil was four segments. Encode actual manufacture-ready segments natively to avoid an unsupported steel island.
paste.qualification: 0.15mm bridges and85% reductions are existing project assembly choices, not PUI part-specific stencil approval. Four deposited arcs must coalesce into a sealed solder ring during reflow; inspect/measure on first boards.

baseline_CAM.conclusion: Native MULTI FILL e13 is an actual undersized NPTH; confirmed in exported Excellon, not inferred from its name.

local_checks.limits: Analytic/local artwork checks only; not native DRC, drill registration capability, CAM union verification or physical assembly validation.

release_checks: Preserve all numbered native pins and networks; inspect library-derived-instance assignment after project save/reopen.
U301 exactly12 unique0.30mm plated holes,0.60mm pads with solid GND paths; zero central paste and exactly40 peripheral paste windows.
U301 all4 copper layers empty in in-board antenna keepout; no unrelated component, battery, speaker or cable occupying the3D exclusion.
U803 exactly1 unique0.60mm NPTH at correct port, no0.30mm duplicate or plated hit, no tiny extra drill hits from TOP polygon anchor fields.
U803 final copper/mask unions match continuous annuli (r.525..825 and.500..850), no inward copper;6 signal pads remain correctly mapped.
U803 exact6 rectangular plus4 ring-sector paste windows, center steel connected through4 bridges; no automatic paste added on top of explicit windows.
All-layer copper and final drill/paste intersection checks, full native DRC, saved-source and exported Gerber/Excellon hashes before release.
First2 assemblies: microscope inspection of U301 outer leads and module level; verify sound passage and microphone noise/acoustic response; check U301 thermal/RF under sustained load.
